title: Exponential Stabilization of Moving Shockwave in ARZ Traffic Model via Boundary Control: Explicit Gains and Arbitrary Decay Rate
summary: This paper develops boundary feedback controls to stabilize traffic congestion toward a predefined shock equilibrium in the Aw-Rascle-Zhang (ARZ) traffic flow model. We transform the corresponding moving-boundary $2\times2$ hyperbolic system, covering free and congested flow regimes, respectively, into a shock-free $4\times4$ augmented system on a fixed domain via shock-location-based moving coordinates.
